events.q: This portrait of Theodore Roosevelt was painted by renowned artist John Singer Sargent in 1903.

events.n: the commission: McKim invited Sargent to paint the portrait
events.q: Architect Charles McKim, who oversaw major renovations to the White House occurring at the time, invited Sargent to paint Roosevelt's portrait.

events.n: letter to his son Kermit on the last sitting
events.q: On February 19 he wrote in a letter to his son Kermit, noting that "This afternoon I had my last sitting with Mr. Sargent. I like his picture enormously."
